notes: REVIEWED AND HARDENED: GRA E-VAT, OPENING IMPORTS, PAYROLL AND THE YEAR-END CLOSE. GRA E-VAT stays off until you switch it on (Settings, Tax — GRA E-VAT); when on, a reversed signed invoice is refunded at GRA, a number GRA already holds is shown as a clash to check on GRA's portal (an administrator records “GRA holds it”), Retry answers at once, and the invoice form warns when a discount line's rate cannot be signed. Opening items brought forward: an approval holds what each row came to, an import is taken back only with its Undo, staff loans post without names, and one invoice number is one invoice. A posted payroll is reversed only from Payroll, Monthly run; a supplier bank file pays only posted transfers. The year closes only into the accumulated fund, never the opening balances clearing account, and the close warns if that account carries a balance. The Help guide covers all of it. Installing: database changes (0223–0227) that alter no posted figure. Carries everything in 0.6.145. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
